scope: All 79 imported .ma sources have source-reviewed classifications and strict expectations justified against concrete parsing, scope, typing, admissibility, or size-change rules. Executable validation and unresolved M1 release obligations are recorded separately; this inventory alone is not a completed M1 exit record.
diagnosticPolicy: Every asserted rejection has one exact category. An unknown outcome, a parse/scope failure instead of a semantic diagnostic, or a different diagnostic fails the case. Expectations must not be regenerated from checker output.
